hook.rumour: Cracked glass ampoules of warm amber sap washed up in Leyawiin's reed-canals at dawn, and An-Xileel scouts have been sighted along the eastern mangrove causeway.
hook.notice: LEYAWIIN HARBOUR WATCH & CHAPEL OF ZENITHAR: Envoy sought to trace the illicit Hist-sap ampoules before border hostilities erupt along the Niben mouth.

stages.objective: Examine the washed-up amber ampoules at Leyawiin's Tide-Gate dock
Question the Argonian reed-weavers at Blankenmarch about the midnight flatboats
Return the stamped copper crate-seal to the Leyawiin harbour watch

objectives.text: Examine the washed-up amber ampoules at Leyawiin's Tide-Gate dock
Question the Argonian reed-weavers at Blankenmarch about the midnight flatboats
Return the stamped copper crate-seal to the Leyawiin harbour watch

consequence_detail.summary: The copper crate-seals match the old quartermaster dies of the disbanded Blackwood Company, now bankrolled from the north.

stages.objective: Travel upriver from Leyawiin with the Saxhleel speaker toward Water's Edge
Inspect the copper tapping-spiles driven into the sunken Hist root-runner near Water's Edge
Consult the Khajiit scouts at Border Watch who tracked the sap-mules north

objectives.text: Travel upriver from Leyawiin with the Saxhleel speaker toward Water's Edge
Inspect the copper tapping-spiles driven into the sunken Hist root-runner near Water's Edge
Consult the Khajiit scouts at Border Watch who tracked the sap-mules north

consequence_detail.summary: The tapping-spiles are pulled from the Hist root-runner at Water's Edge, and the Khajiit scouts point to a broker at The Drunken Dragon Inn.

stages.objective: Cross the marsh road east from Border Watch to The Drunken Dragon Inn
Defeat the sap-broker's bodyguards at The Drunken Dragon Inn and seize the Sap Ledger
Meet the An-Xileel border-envoy at Blankenmarch to show proof of the northern buyers

objectives.text: Cross the marsh road east from Border Watch to The Drunken Dragon Inn
Defeat the sap-broker's bodyguards at The Drunken Dragon Inn and seize the Sap Ledger
Meet the An-Xileel border-envoy at Blankenmarch to show proof of the northern buyers

consequence_detail.summary: The Sap Ledger proves the Council of Ash in the capital was buying refined Hist sap to provoke a border crisis at Leyawiin.

stages.objective: Destroy the hidden copper sap-stills in the mangroves outside Blankenmarch
Deliver the living Hist root-cutting to the Saxhleel elders in Leyawiin
Witness Count Caro and the marsh envoys seal the Niben Mouth Border Truce

objectives.text: Destroy the hidden copper sap-stills in the mangroves outside Blankenmarch

consequence_detail.summary: The illegal sap-stills are destroyed, the living Hist cutting is returned to the marsh elders, and peace holds along the Blackwood border.
